title: UP conformance case expectation
description: The expected outcome of parsing the sibling input.up. One object per case directory.

expect.description: Whether a conforming parser MUST accept (parse) or reject (error) the input.

model.description: expect=parse only. The data model the parse MUST yield, as an order-significant JSON projection: a string value is a JSON string, a block is a JSON object (key order significant), a list is a JSON array. Every scalar is a string — there is no type inference or coercion. An annotated member (Rung 2) projects as a tagged value object {"$annotation": {"name": <id>, "args": <raw>?}, "$value": <value projection>}: $annotation.name is the captured identifier, $annotation.args (present only when the use site wrote parentheses) is the raw text inside (…), and $value is the member's ordinary value projection. A member with no annotation is its bare value projection, unwrapped. List items are never annotated.

lint.description: expect=parse only. Lint warning codes (W_*) a linter SHOULD emit for this input, in any order. Absent or [] means no warnings.

code.description: expect=error only. The stable error code (E_*) the parser MUST report. Match by code, not message text.

error_contains.description: expect=error, provisional only. A substring the error message contains, used where no stable error code is assigned yet (a rung whose spec is not finalized).

rung_exact.description: The expectation holds ONLY for a parser implementing exactly this rung, not cumulatively. Used for 'feature not yet supported' rejections (e.g. E_INLINE_UNSUPPORTED at Rung 0) whose input becomes valid at a higher rung. A runner for rung N MUST skip a rung_exact case from a lower rung.

provisional.description: The expectation is NOT yet spec-final: it reflects the draft suite for a rung whose specification (notably the data model and error codes) is still being written. Provisional cases are excluded from a conformance verdict and exist to record intent and to light up once their rung lands.

note.description: Human-readable explanation of what the case pins.
